questions.question:
Select the most appropriate option to substitute the underlined segment in the given sentence.

The meeting in the conference hall has ended on a __temporary agreement__.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 2 (Truce)**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"Truce"** refers to an agreement between opposing parties to stop fighting or arguing for a certain period. (युद्धविराम)

 
 
• **Example: **Both countries agreed to a **truce** to allow for peace negotiations.
 
 
 
• In the context of the sentence, "**truce**" is the most appropriate word because the meeting concluded on a temporary agreement, which is akin to a truce.

**​**Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 2 (Truce)**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Agenda** (एजेंडा): A list of items to be discussed at a meeting.

 
 
• **Example:** The **agenda **for today's meeting includes budget planning and project updates.
 
 
 
• **Fight** (लड़ाई): A violent confrontation or struggle.
 
 
• **Example:** The **fight **between the two teams was intense and thrilling.
 
 
 
• **Hot War** (युद्ध): A conflict involving active military combat, as opposed to a cold war.
 
 
• **Example:** The region has been in a state of **hot war** for several years.

The following sentence has been divided into parts. One of them may contain an error. Select the part that contains the error from the given options. If you don’t find any error, mark ‘No error’ as your answer.

At 6 p.m. tomorrow, / I will have been studied / for five hours straight.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is **Option 1**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The phrase "I will have been studied" contains a grammatical error in the use of the verb form.
 
• For future perfect continuous tense, the correct structure is "will have been" + present participle (verb+ing), e.g., "will have been studying."
 
• The incorrect use of the past participle "studied" instead of "studying" violates the tense formation rules.
 
• Thus, the error is located in **part 1** of the sentence.

Therefore, the correct answer is **1**.

 

**Correct Sentence:** *"At 6 p.m. tomorrow, I will have been **studying** for five hours straight."*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Part 4: "At 6 p.m. tomorrow,"** is a correct time phrase indicating a future reference point.
 
• **Part 3: "for five hours straight."** correctly expresses the duration of the action.
 
• **No error** option is incorrect as the sentence contains a clear tense error in part 1.

questions.question:
Select the correct collocation to fill in the blank.

The CEO has a ______ effect on the future of the company, which includes global expansion.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is '**far-reaching**'.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** 

__
 
• The collocation "**far-reaching effect**" means having a significant and extensive impact, especially over a long distance or time.
 
• In the given sentence, it refers to the CEO's influence that affects the future direction of the company, including global expansion.
 
• The other options do not collocate well with "effect" in this context:
 
 
• "grand effect" is not a common collocation.
 
• "broad effect" is less idiomatic than "far-reaching effect."
 
• "gorgeous effect" is inappropriate as "gorgeous" relates to appearance, not influence.
 
 

​Therefore, the correct answer is '**Option 2**'.

**Complete Sentence:** *The CEO has a **far-reaching**__ effect on the future of the company, which includes global expansion.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__** 

 
• **Grand:** Usually describes something impressive in size or appearance, but does not commonly pair with "effect."
 
• **Broad:** Means wide in scope, but "broad effect" is less commonly used compared to "far-reaching effect."
 
• **Gorgeous:** Refers to something very beautiful, and is unrelated to the idea of influence or impact.

questions.solution:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The phrase "the sinking of the passenger-and-car ferry Estonia (1) ____ the Baltic" requires a preposition that indicates location or area where the sinking happened.
 
• "In the Baltic" is the correct collocation because it refers to the ferry sinking within the Baltic Sea.
 
• Other options such as "on the Baltic," "over the Baltic," and "up the Baltic" do not correctly describe the location in this maritime context.
 
• "On" typically refers to surfaces (e.g., "on the lake") but is less appropriate for naming seas; "over" implies movement above something; "up" implies direction, none of which fit the sentence meaning.

Therefore, the correct answer is '**Option 3**'.

 

**Complete Passage: ***Naval architects never claim that a ship is unsinkable, but the sinking of the passenger-and-car ferry Estonia **in__** the Baltic surely (2) ______ never have happened.
